newsitem.title: USA: U.S. domestic crudes slide lower, Oct expiry firms.
newsitem.headline: U.S. domestic crudes slide lower, Oct expiry firms.

text.p: U.S. crudes ended stronger on an outright basis, turning losses into gains as October futures contracts expired in a positive stance.
Domestic grades slipped lower as the afternoon progressed, reflecting the fundamental choppiness in the cash market and trades getting done at weaker levels against the firming crude outright levels.
Fundamental fears for overstocked gasoline storage have pressured the market, while heating oil has acted as a boost.
Oct West Texas Intermediate/Cushing ended at $23.55-$23.65 a barrel, 10-15 cts higher from Thursday's closing levels.
